packages.name: Community Co-Host
packages.tagline: Show up, meet the community, and get a table at Thursday Gatherings. No cash required — bring value to the room.

perks.text: Dedicated table at Thursday Gatherings
Listed as community co-host on event page
Intro to the community at event start
1 social media mention per event

packages.name: Event Sponsor
packages.tagline: Brand visibility before, during, and after a single event. Ideal for product launches, hiring campaigns, or market research.

perks.text: Logo on event page and email blast (500+ subscribers)
Branded table + pull-up banner space at venue
3-minute intro slot at event start
Listed as sponsor on Exponanta community page
3 social media posts (pre, during, post event)
Attendee list (opt-in only)

packages.name: Series Sponsor
packages.tagline: Sustained presence across all events in a month. Best for building brand recognition with a community that attends regularly.

perks.text: Logo on all event pages and emails for the month
Branded presence at all Thursday Gatherings (4–5 events)
Featured sponsor slot on community.html member directory
5-minute speaking slot at one featured event
Weekly social media mention across all channels
Full attendee list with opt-in contacts
Post-month impact report (reach, clicks, attendance)

packages.name: Strategic Partner
packages.tagline: A fully custom partnership built around your specific goals — hiring, deal flow, brand building, or research. Let's design it together.

perks.text: Named co-host on all Exponanta events for the quarter
Custom event co-design — your topic, our audience
Homepage logo placement for 3 months
Dedicated community email to 500+ members
Quarterly keynote or panel speaking slot
Access to Exponanta member CRM for opt-in outreach
Quarterly business review + custom impact reporting
